fullTextZH: 如果你看到它们开花了，
fullTextEN: If you see them blooming,

fullTextZH: 记得出门的时候要带一把伞哦。
fullTextEN: Remember to take an umbrella when you go out.
Hello,
I am Xika,
I am Taiwanese,
I live in the UK.

fullTextZH: 今天我要介绍一种特别的花。
fullTextEN: Today I want to introduce a special flower.

fullTextZH: 你知道有一种花可以告诉你天气吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know there is a flower that can tell you the weather?

fullTextZH: 有一种花喜欢刮风下雨的天气，
fullTextEN: There is a flower that likes windy and rainy weather,

fullTextZH: 下雨的时候这种花就会开花，
fullTextEN: When it rains, this flower will bloom,

fullTextZH: 所以这种花的名字叫做风雨花。
fullTextEN: So this flower is called the wind and rain flower.
Where are the wind and rain flowers?

fullTextZH: 在南美洲、中国和台湾都有风雨花。
fullTextEN: In South America, China, and Taiwan, there are wind and rain flowers.
Wind and rain flowers have different colors,
There are pink ones,
There are yellow ones,
There are also white ones.
Its leaves are thin,
Not thick,
Thin,
Long.
You can in summer and
see during autumn.

fullTextZH: 风雨花开花，每次要刮风下雨之前，
fullTextEN: The wind and rain flower blooms, every time before it gets windy and rainy,
the weather becomes very stuffy and hot.

fullTextZH: 这种闷热的天气我们会觉得很不舒服。
fullTextEN: This kind of stuffy weather makes us feel very uncomfortable.
We will sweat,

fullTextZH: 可是风雨花喜欢这种天气，
fullTextEN: but the wind and rain flower likes this kind of weather,

fullTextZH: 所以大家常常看到下雨的时候好多好多的风雨花都开了，
fullTextEN: so everyone often sees many, many wind and rain flowers blooming when it rains,
The heavier the rain,
the more flowers bloom and the more beautiful they are.
There is also a kind of flower called Mirabilis jalapa,
its color is purplish-red.
Mirabilis jalapa also has other colors,
like yellow or white,

fullTextZH: 但是大部分是紫红色的，
fullTextEN: but mostly it is purplish-red,
so it's called Mirabilis jalapa.

fullTextZH: 紫茉莉也会告诉你是不是要下雨了。
fullTextEN: Mirabilis jalapa can also tell you if it's going to rain.

fullTextZH: 通常紫茉莉在下午开花，
fullTextEN: Usually, Mirabilis jalapa blooms in the afternoon,
and withers the next morning.

fullTextZH: 可是如果你起床了看到，
fullTextEN: But if you wake up and see,
Oh,
the four o'clock flowers are still blooming and haven't wilted,
then wait a moment,
it might rain,

fullTextZH: 因为紫茉莉也喜欢湿湿热热的天气，
fullTextEN: because four o'clock flowers also like humid and hot weather,

fullTextZH: 花也会告诉人天气是不是很可爱呢。
fullTextEN: flowers can also tell people if the weather is cute, right?

fullTextZH: 在你家的花园或附近的公园有没有这种花呢？
fullTextEN: Is there such a flower in your garden or nearby park?

fullTextZH: 如果你看到它们开花了，
fullTextEN: If you see them blooming,

fullTextZH: 记得出门的时候要带一把伞哦。
fullTextEN: remember to take an umbrella when you go out.

fullTextZH: 你还想认识更多有趣的植物吗？
fullTextEN: Do you want to learn about more interesting plants?

fullTextZH: 像是会笑的树或是长得像人的花。
fullTextEN: Like trees that laugh or flowers that look like people.

fullTextZH: 欢迎你去 Lazy Chinese 的网站，
fullTextEN: You're welcome to visit the Lazy Chinese website,
there are more videos there.
See you next time,
bye!
